name: Marketplace Prospect and Catalogue-Tax Audit
description: Evaluate third-party plugins / skills / MCP servers for adoption while MEASURING and CAPPING the per-turn context tax they impose - adopt-with-budget, not adopt-and-forget. Three things make this a governance blueprint rather than a research one: the tax is measured with an instrument that is itself validated against a control (a plugin that measures zero tax means the instrument is broken, not that the plugin is free); an artifact that ships its own hooks directory and is not a registered marketplace is QUARANTINED pending security review, because a cloned marketplace can auto-load hooks the moment an agent runs in it; and the enable/disable is applied at USER scope only, since project scope silently returns when the working directory changes.

catalogue_root.description: The installed plugin / skill / MCP tree to inventory

context_budget_tokens.description: The per-turn context ceiling; a DO verdict must fit inside it

control_artifact.description: A KNOWN-installed artifact used to validate the tax instrument: enabling it must measure NON-ZERO

inventory-agent.description: Inventories the installed catalogue and measures today's baseline per-turn tax

candidate-evaluator.description: Evaluates one candidate: licence, maintenance signal, hook surface, tool count - and refuses a DO without a recorded licence

tax-measurer.description: Measures the delta per-turn tax of enabling a candidate, with a control proving the instrument can register a non-zero reading

budget-reconciler.description: Decides DO / DEFER / DROP against the declared token budget; a candidate whose tax cannot be measured is DEFER, never DO

owner.description: The human owner - the only role that may authorise an install or a deregistration

routes.reason: the tax is a measurement; a model estimate of it is exactly the fiction this blueprint replaces

stages.title: Inventory the installed catalogue and measure today's baseline tax

work_unit.title: Enumerate installed artifacts, their enable state and scope, and the baseline per-turn token cost
work_unit.question_or_target: Inventory every installed plugin, skill and MCP server with its enable state AND the scope that enable lives at, then measure the baseline per-turn context cost. Installed-but-disabled is the common case and must be counted separately from enabled.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: counts of installed vs enabled with the config file and key each enable state was read from; a state inferred without a file read is not recorded
tests_required: the installed count must exceed the enabled count on this estate; equality means the reader is reading one field for both
an enable recorded at project scope must be reported as project-scoped, because it returns when the cwd changes
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the tax measurer refuses to compute a delta against a baseline whose source files are not named
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0401 emitted only when every installed artifact has an enable state, a scope, and the file the state was read from; the baseline tax is recorded; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0401 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: Validate the tax instrument against a known-installed control

work_unit.title: Prove the tax instrument registers a non-zero reading on a control artifact
work_unit.question_or_target: Measure the per-turn tax with the control artifact enabled and disabled. The delta MUST be greater than zero. A zero reading means the instrument is broken, and every later measurement it produces is meaningless.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a measurement plus its control; the whole blueprint rests on this instrument being real

work_unit.evidence_requirement: both readings (enabled, disabled), the delta, and the exact command that produced each - a delta asserted without two readings is not a measurement
tests_required: MANDATORY both-states: the control artifact must measure NON-ZERO tax when enabled and the baseline must be reproducible when it is disabled
if the instrument reports zero for a known-heavy artifact the stage must FAIL, not record zero
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the budget reconciler treats any candidate measured after a failed control as unmeasured, hence DEFER
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0402 emitted only when the control delta is greater than zero and both readings carry their producing commands; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0402 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts; a second zero reading fails the control

stages.title: A zero-reading instrument measures nothing: block before spending on candidates
Evaluate each candidate: licence, maintenance, hook surface, tool count

work_unit.title: Record licence, maintenance signal, hook surface, tool count and registration status
work_unit.question_or_target: For the assigned candidate record: its licence (verbatim), its maintenance signal, whether it ships its own hooks directory, whether it is a REGISTERED marketplace, and how many tools it adds. A candidate shipping hooks while unregistered is flagged for quarantine.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the licence text is quoted from the artifact's own file; the hook surface is a directory listing, not an inference
tests_required: an artifact shipping its own hooks directory and absent from the registered marketplace list must be flagged for QUARANTINE
a candidate with no discoverable licence must be recorded licence-unknown, which makes DO impossible downstream
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the quarantine gate blocks admission of any flagged artifact regardless of its other scores
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0403 emitted only when every candidate has a licence field, a hook-surface finding, a registration status and a tool count; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0403 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: Optional S1b: a byte-level duplicate marketplace is pure tax

work_unit.title: Detect duplicate and orphaned marketplace clones by content hash
work_unit.question_or_target: Hash the marketplace trees and report duplicates and orphans. A byte-level duplicate adds catalogue tax and zero capability; an orphaned clone is registered to nothing and may still ship hooks.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each duplicate group lists its member paths and the shared content hash; an orphan names the registration it lacks
tests_required: MANDATORY: the known orphaned marketplace clones on this estate must be detected - a clean result on a box that has them means the detector is wrong
two trees differing by one byte must NOT be reported as duplicates
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner decides deregistration; this stage only reports
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0404 emitted only when every marketplace tree is hashed and grouped, and each orphan names its missing registration; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0404 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: Measure the per-turn tax each candidate would ADD

work_unit.title: Measure each candidate's delta tax against the validated baseline
work_unit.question_or_target: For each candidate measure the per-turn token delta it would add, using the instrument the control validated. A candidate whose tax cannot be measured is recorded UNMEASURED - which forces DEFER, never DO.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a measurement against a validated instrument, not an estimate

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each delta names the baseline it was measured against and the command that produced the reading; an UNMEASURED row states why
tests_required: a candidate adding many tools must measure a larger delta than one adding a single tool - a flat reading across both means the instrument is not resolving
an unmeasurable candidate must be UNMEASURED, never zero
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the budget reconciler cannot promote an UNMEASURED candidate to DO
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0405 emitted only when every candidate has a delta tax or an explicit UNMEASURED reason, each naming its baseline; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0405 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts; a second failure records UNMEASURED

stages.title: DO / DEFER / DROP against the declared context budget

work_unit.title: Reconcile every candidate against the token budget and emit a scoped decision
work_unit.question_or_target: Decide DO / DEFER / DROP per candidate: DO requires a recorded licence, a measured delta, no quarantine flag, and room inside the context budget. Every DO records that it will be applied at USER scope.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the artifact states the budget, the sum of admitted deltas, and the remaining headroom numerically; each verdict names its blocking condition where not DO
tests_required: a candidate with no licence must never be DO
the sum of admitted deltas must not exceed the declared budget
a quarantine-flagged candidate must never be DO regardless of its tax
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner approves before anything is applied; the quarantine gate runs first
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0406 emitted only when every candidate has a verdict, the admitted delta sum fits the budget, and every DO is marked user-scope; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0406 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: No unregistered hook-shipping artifact, no unlicensed DO, no project-scope enable
Owner authorises the installs and any deregistration
stages.prompt: These picks fit the declared context budget. Authorise the DO list to be enabled at USER scope, authorise deregistration of the orphaned clones, or decline. A quarantined artifact is not in this list and needs a security review first.

stages.title: Apply at USER scope only, and record the scope that was written

work_unit.title: Enable or disable at USER scope and verify the scope actually written
work_unit.question_or_target: Apply the authorised verdicts at USER scope, then RE-READ the config and confirm the change landed at user scope. A change written at project scope silently returns when the working directory changes, so the durable cure is the scope, not the toggle.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: apply-then-verify: the verification is a re-read, not a claim

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per change: the command run, the config file re-read afterwards, and the scope the key was found at - a change asserted without a re-read is not verified
tests_required: both-states: a change written at user scope must be found at user scope on re-read; a change that lands at project scope must FAIL this stage
the post-change tax must be re-measured and compared against the predicted delta
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner decision record and this report are read together, so an applied change outside the authorised list is visible
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPG-0407 emitted only when every authorised change is applied, re-read, and confirmed at USER scope, with the post-change tax measured; otherwise FAILED:BPG-0407 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed applications, revert and report rather than a third attempt

impact.blast_radius: mutates the agent catalogue enable state at USER scope after owner authorisation; every change is re-read and recorded

derived_from.credit: owner (USER-scope disable cure, the two root causes)

contraindications: NOT for first-party owner artifacts - no licence question and no tax surprise
NOT a security review of the artifact's CODE: a quarantine flag hands that to a security blueprint
x_extensions.why_not_a_duplicate_of_bp_gem_02: BP-GEM-02 judges candidates against a declared architecture list and a budget using set arithmetic and NO measurement. This one MEASURES an instrument-validated quantity (per-turn context tax), evaluates licences, and mutates the catalogue at a verified scope. One is arithmetic over declarations; the other is a measurement plus an apply-then-verify.
unverified: UNVERIFIED as a combined pass; settling experiment = run it over the disabled plugins on this estate and see whether ANY DO verdict survives its own budget check.
x_extensions.owner_decision: What per-turn context budget is the ceiling, and does a marketplace declared RETIRED but still registered get deregistered now?

worked_example.name: evaluate three third-party plugins against a 40k per-turn budget
acceptance: the control artifact measures a NON-ZERO tax delta
the known orphaned marketplace clones are detected
a candidate shipping its own hooks while unregistered is quarantined, not adopted
every applied change is re-read and confirmed at USER scope

stopping_rule_controls.why: the floor stops a completed-looking run whose tax instrument never worked
a zero control reading must escalate, because every later measurement is then meaningless
